in_telugu.name: గురుపద
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is devoted to the Guru's feet

in_marathi.name: Gurupada
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurupada हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Guru’ (teacher) and ‘Pada’ (feet), signifying one who is graced by the guru’s teachings.

in_bengali.name: Gurupada
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Guru's Grace
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gurupada একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Guru’ (teacher) and ‘Pada’ (feet), signifying one who is graced by the guru’s teachings.
